scope.description: Whole kicad application/library breadth across useful functional families.
scope.denominator: Schematic capture, PCB layout/routing, libraries, design checks, manufacturing outputs and electronics project management.

coverage.rationale: Useful manufacturing review covers only a small portion of the suite; schematic, board authoring and most fabrication outputs are absent.

scope.description: Read-only saved-board inspection, design-rule checking and Excellon drill publication.
scope.denominator: User intent and domain decisions within the named supported workflows, including declared inputs, composition and useful outputs; excluded application features do not enter this score.

abstraction.rationale: Board checks and drill intent hide command and readback plumbing, but remain close to native tools and require a finished design.

limitations: Bounded existing boards and through-via/drill subset; no board authoring, zone refill, schematic parity, Gerbers or placement outputs.

Editorial estimate from current contracts, guidance and completion evidence; no exhaustive native API denominator or new native acceptance was measured for this assessment. Qualification and runtime availability must be queried separately.
